Drums_error_regions.bright_local_peak_rule: minRGB>.55; minRGB minus11x11 local average>.15; every alpha value in5x5 neighborhood>.9. Existing neutral_peaks additionally require local desaturation contrast>.15.

AnisoMetal_error_regions.scope: All400 official AnisoMetal views, existing saved renders, CPU-only diagnostic against v2. Region shares describe pooled RGB squared-error differences, not mean PSNR or physical material causes.
AnisoMetal_error_regions.region_rules: Interior: all5x5 alpha>.9; background alpha<=.01; edge otherwise. Local peaks: value>.55 and value minus11x11 mean>.15 inside interior. Luminance uses Rec709 coefficients; neutral uses minRGB.
